latest.title: AIdeas 2025: Selective Enforcement & a Senior AWS Manager's Deleted LinkedIn Post
latest.description: Two AWS Student Builder Group Leaders won Regional Champion titles in the AWS 10,000 AIdeas Competition, publicly celebrated together by a Senior AWS Program Manager on LinkedIn and on AWS Builder Center. After community concerns were raised, one was quietly removed from the winners list and the celebrating LinkedIn post was deleted — both without any public explanation. The other remains the EMEA Regional Champion. The documented evidence, with screenshots, is inside.

latest.title: AWS S3 Files just made Transfer Family SFTP obsolete for most use cases
latest.description: AWS just launched one of the most impactful storage features in years: S3 Files. It puts an EFS-compatible file system interface directly in front of your S3 buckets. When I was introduced to S3 Files, I immediately thought of SFTP as the most obvious use case for my clients.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.
